lock:
The supplied reference image is the identity anchor. Photograph the same real person on another ordinary day.

Keep the same face: bone structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, and natural asymmetries. Same apparent age, skin tone, pores, and small blemishes. Same body shape and proportions. Hair stays the same color and length; only the shot may change how it is worn. Makeup stays at the same everyday level. Skin is unretouched, with visible texture.

Realistic anatomy, including hands and fingers. Ordinary snapshot: available light, natural color, mild photographic imperfections. The person looks like themselves, not a retouched model.

Follow the shot for pose, camera, clothing, lighting, and place. Identity stays fixed.
